note: Curated walking tours; routes follow mapped paths and are illustrative only — not for navigation.

tours.title: HKU essentials: Centennial Campus to the Main Building
tours.summary: From HKU MTR station through the Centennial Campus and the Main Library to the declared monuments of the old campus: the Main Building, Hung Hing Ying, Eliot Hall and May Hall.

stops.name: HKU Station (MTR Island Line)
stops.text: HKU station on the MTR Island Line, below the campus; its exits lead up to the Centennial Campus and Pok Fu Lam Road.

stops.name: Centennial Gate
stops.text: Centennial Gate: the entrance to the Centennial Campus.

stops.name: The Jockey Club Tower
stops.text: The Jockey Club Tower on the Centennial Campus; a café and a bank branch are mapped inside.

stops.name: Run Run Shaw Tower
stops.text: Run Run Shaw Tower; the Music Library and a restaurant are mapped inside.

stops.name: Lee Shau Kee Lecture Centre
stops.text: Lee Shau Kee Lecture Centre, with large lecture theatres; a restaurant is mapped inside.

stops.name: Library Building (New Wing)
stops.text: Library Building (New Wing): the HKU Main Library.

stops.name: Fung Ping Shan Building
stops.text: Fung Ping Shan Building, home of the University Museum and Art Gallery; its exterior is a declared monument.

stops.name: Main Building
stops.text: Main Building: the University's first building, opened in 1912, around two courtyards. Its exterior is a declared monument.

stops.name: Sun Yat-sen Place
stops.text: Sun Yat-sen Place, the open square by the Main Building.

stops.name: Hung Hing Ying Building
stops.text: Hung Hing Ying Building (1919), a declared monument.

stops.name: Chong Yuet Ming Amenities Centre
stops.text: Chong Yuet Ming Amenities Centre: cafés and fast food are mapped inside.

stops.name: Eliot Hall
stops.text: Eliot Hall (1914) and, next to it, May Hall (1915): former halls of residence, both declared monuments.

stops.name: Meng Wah Complex
stops.text: Meng Wah Complex: the University Health Service is mapped inside.
